title: Seacrest Beach "Shorely From Heaven" 434 Beach Bike Way
h1: Seacrest Beach "Shorely From Heaven" 434 Beach Bike Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the deeded beach access or take the complimentary tram- Access to Seacrest's 12,000-square-foot community pool and multiple community parks (including one directly across the street)- 4 adult bikes provided- Private balconies- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout*Please note this community requires a Guest Registration Form to be completed within two weeks of arrival to access the community amenities.DETAILS: This gorgeous Seacrest Beach escape is Shorely From Heaven! Boasting 4 bedrooms and 5 bathrooms, this 3-story home sleeps up to 12 guests for enchanting family and group getaways. Known for its laid-back atmosphere and quaint beach town allure, Seacrest Beach offers a blissful setting for relaxing along the coast. Savor the sunshine beside the community’s sprawling Lagoon Pool or enjoy a picnic in one of the many neighborhood parks. With beach access less than a 10-minute walk away, this home has everything guests need for an unforgettable 30A retreat!Elegant coastal style reigns throughout this light-filled beach abode, starting with the spacious front porch that welcomes guests. In the first-level living space, a cloud-soft sofa and sisal rug set the scene for leisurely hangouts with the group, while a cozy breakfast table, illuminated by natural light, provides the perfect spot to split a bottle of wine or enjoy morning coffee while reminiscing about adventures. Gather for formal meals at the weathered wooden dining table for 6; extra seating for 4 is available at the breakfast bar. Seamlessly connected to the living and dining spaces is the stunning kitchen, featuring high-end appliances and fully equipped for making meals, so the conversation never has to end! Down the hall is a laundry nook for refreshing towels and beachwear.The second level is where guests will find the first of the home’s inviting sleeping accommodations. Choose between a charming guest bedroom with a king bed or a spacious bunk room with a queen-over-queen bunk, twin-over-twin bunk, and balcony—all the bedrooms feature a private bathroom.On the third level, enjoy a peaceful night in the primary bedroom or guest bedroom, each boasting a king bed and a balcony.Seacrest Beach amenities and beautiful accommodations make Shorely From Heaven a perfect escape for carefree beach days. Guests can easily explore nearby Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach thanks to on-site parking, or take advantage of the 4 complimentary adult bikes and neighborhood tram service. For beach access, use the access directly south of the Lagoon Pool, located at The Villas at Sunset Beach. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12):SECOND FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed and Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.
